title: Contrix Standard Event Payloads
description: Common payload contracts for registered cx.* Event.kind values. Event validators MUST combine these payload classes with artifacts/registry/event-kind-registry.json.

patch_path.description: Contrix field patch path. Segments are snake_case identifiers, optional stable-key selectors such as branches[name=discussion], or backtick-quoted literals; numeric array indexes are not part of cx.patch.v1.

patch_value.description: A plain value is shorthand for {"$op":"set","value":...}. Objects containing $op MUST be patch_operation objects.

crypto_device_payload.description: Deprecated compatibility union. Event validators SHOULD use the kind-specific payload defs for security-sensitive device, MLS, and space key events.
